notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide (src/guides/comparisonbar.guide.tsx) and docs/evidence/comparisonbar.md at ea46f68 (“docs: add Comparison Bar guide”). The guide's Sources note says “Checked 28 October 2026” on the 27 October build of Biscuit's main, and the evidence's Checked section names it exactly: jfs-components 0.1.78 from mirror tag v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October), checked 28 October 2026, with installed and upstream ComparisonBar.tsx byte-identical. That is the installed build, so every item citing the note or the evidence carries 2026-10-28 and 0.1.78-dbe0e02, and none is stale. (npm run coin:status on 29 October: upstream main has one newer commit, 9a999cd, 28 October, not in the mirror; not checked here.) Installed ComparisonBar.tsx, Button.tsx and IconCapsule.tsx still match every guide and evidence sentence used here, read from source, not run (token values through the package's own resolver): the card is a row with alignSelf flex-start and no wrap or scroll, 12 px horizontal and 10 px vertical padding, a 12 px gap, radius 12, white with a 1 px #f5f5f5 border; slots are 45 × 44 Pressables with role button, #ebebed, radius 8, padding 8 / 6, so a picture is 33 × 28; an item is filled when imageSource is neither null nor '' and then the whole slot calls onItemRemove, with the close capsule set to pointerEvents none; an empty slot calls onItemPress; the default slot labels are “Add item to comparison” and “Remove item from comparison”, and a filled slot's Image gets the same accessibilityLabel (or “Comparison item image”); Compare is a Button with the bar's own modes and label compareLabel (default “Compare”), disabled by compareDisabled ?? (disableCompareWhenEmpty && no image), and a disabled Button is 50 % opacity with no onPress; Button M resolves to 20 / 8 padding and 16/24 type (42 px tall), S to 16 / 4 and 14/22 (32 px), gold #cea15a; Radius changes only image/radius (S 8, M 16, L 32, None 0); the add capsule takes the bar's modes plus Icon Capsule Size XS (18 px, 12 px glyph) on a transparent background, its glyph dark #0f0d0a by default and white under AppearanceBrand Secondary, Neutral or Tertiary or Semantic Intent System, #93713a under Emphasis Medium; the close capsule forces AppearanceBrand Neutral and Emphasis Medium (XS). No guide or evidence sentence is contradicted on dbe0e02. Every Component Bug #421 problem the guide and evidence name is still in this source: the + takes the bar's brand modes (addCapsuleModes spreads the bar's modes and overrides only the size), the + is XS while the comment above ADD_CAPSULE_STYLE says S, the picture is 28 tall and the right padding 12, the Compare button is the default M gold Button, the slots have no pressed style, and the row neither wraps nor scrolls. Not in the guide or evidence, from the source only and not recorded: Semantic Intent System on the bar also reaches the close capsule (green). Modes: the guide sets Color Mode Light on every bar, list and stack, Button / Size S on the playground and Configuration's Button / Size S card, Radius on two cards, and Button / Size S with Emphasis Medium or Low on the In context Add buttons. Button / Size S matches Figma's drawing (Configuration “Button / Size S gives the smaller button Figma draws”): a guide choice for its pictures, not a rule that some content needs it, so the examples leave every mode at its default (Compare is Coin's Button at size M, gold), and Button / Size S and Radius are recorded as configuration items that say what each does. No Color Mode anywhere. The In context VStack keeps alignHorizontal stretch (layout) and drops Slot gap L; the ListGroup and ComparisonBar drop their Color Mode. The In context rows' trailing Buttons carry no modes: a ListItem gives the Buttons in its slots their look (building rules), so the guide's Size S and Emphasis Medium / Low are left out; the Add and Added labels stay. Components: ListGroup and ListItem have entries (undocumented: facts only), so the In context example uses them as the guide composes it; Avatar has no entry, so per the building rule “Use only components with an entry” the rows leave out the guide's leading Avatar pictures rather than swap in another component (ListItem's leading is optional). Image sources: the guide's pictures are docs assets (gold-coin.png, jio-gold-logo.png, bank-hero.png); the examples pass { uri: 'https://example.com/gold-coin.png' }, which stands for each coin's own picture, as the ProfileCard entry passes a { uri } for a logo. Copy is the guide's own: Gold coins, 1 g, 2 g, 5 g and 10 g gold coin with their ₹ and 24K support lines, Add, Added (the guide's label for an added coin, src line 64; the snapshot renders before any pick, so only Add is in it), Compare, and the “Remove 1 g gold coin” label the guide builds for a picked coin; the ids are the guide's (1g, empty-0 … in context; a, b, c, d in Configuration). The In context example shows one coin picked, so Compare is on. Left out of examples (three at most): the playground and its Readout, Two slots, Radius None and L (square photos), compareLabel Compare 4, All empty and All added, the content sentence card, the In context status line (“Add coins to compare”, a documentation readout, not Coin), the FitWidth host and the Don'ts. avoidWhen rests on the evidence's opening (not a value chart); it names Allocation Comparison Chart and Plan Comparison Card as the evidence does, with no useInstead, because the evidence names both “and others” and neither has an entry. Not recorded: style (the building rules keep style off Coin components); Button / State Disabled and the brand colour modes on the Compare button, which the evidence's Limits keep out of the guide; the evidence's Web render tree and Storybook story ids; the line that a filled slot's picture gets the same accessible name as its slot button (rendered: two elements named “Remove 1 g gold coin”), a screen-reader naming detail the pack's rules keep out of gaps and the guide doesn't state. The Sources note renders whole: no line has a missing value.

examples.purpose: Comparing gold coins, the guide's In context: people add coins from the Gold coins list, and the bar fills from the left. Here the 1 g coin is added, so its picture fills the first slot (named for screen readers) and Compare is on. Tapping its picture takes the coin out (onItemRemove), an empty slot asks the screen to add the next coin (onItemPress), and the screen opens the comparison (onCompare). The rows leave out the guide's leading pictures, and their Buttons carry no modes.

evidenceFacts.name: ComparisonBarItem.imageSource
evidenceFacts.description: Set, the slot is filled: its picture and a close mark. null, undefined or an empty string leave it empty, with a +.
evidenceFacts.quote: `imageSource` set = filled (picture and close mark); `null`, `undefined` or `''` = empty (+).

evidenceFacts.name: ComparisonBarItem.accessibilityLabel
evidenceFacts.description: Names the slot. Left out, an empty slot is “Add item to comparison” and a filled one “Remove item from comparison”.
evidenceFacts.quote: `accessibilityLabel` names the slot (default "Add item to comparison" / "Remove item from comparison").

evidenceFacts.name: disableCompareWhenEmpty
evidenceFacts.description: While no slot has an image, Compare is off: 50 % opacity and not pressable. One image turns it on.
evidenceFacts.quote: Off (50 % opacity, not pressable) while no slot has an image (`disableCompareWhenEmpty`, default true); one image turns it on.

evidenceFacts.name: compareDisabled
evidenceFacts.description: Set to true or false, it overrides the automatic behaviour both ways.

evidenceFacts.name: Button / Size
evidenceFacts.description: Sizes the Compare button. With the default M the button is 115 × 42 (16/24 type) and four slots make the bar 369 × 66; with S the button is 98 × 32 (14/22) and the bar 352 × 66.
